label: late-episode GO: repeat a1 after a run of rewards
explanation: Fires only at GO, only late in the episode (none before trial 70; 99% of mass at trials 80-99), and only when the previous trial was rewarded, the agent is choosing a1 (model_act == 1, a confident positive choice logit) and the previous choice was also a1, i.e. staying on a1 after rewards. Requiring the trial two back to also be rewarded raises precision. Magnitude builds up over a run of consecutive rewarded a1 trials and with ep_trial, so it is largest after long streaks near the end of the episode (it also lines up with low value-head output late in the episode). It never fires at D1 or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or when the agent chooses a2. Only uses observed history plus the agent own upcoming choice (no future variables). Precision is about 0.6: many late rewarded a1 stay GO steps are inactive, mostly early in a streak where the ramp has not crossed threshold yet, so this is partially explained. Dev F1 0.73, mass recall 0.98.
